notes.title: Demo Disc Super Update! (July 2025)
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946061/42b0bf659f6611abbb4af7aa87adede072925d48.jpg"]

Hello everyone! This is HedProtag speaking!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946061/7533df7aa9a8fbf47da382ab81ee51ed96548b47.jpg"]  
We are happy to announce the latest massive overhaul to the Demo Disc Level.
The focus of this update was first and foremost to implement the latest UI and UX Overhaul, trough the inclusion of the new revamped Inventory System with 3D Model previews. Enhanced Examine functions, and completely revamped Sound and Art design.... Bug Fixing, and New Demo Level Additions/Improvements are also found in this update. Massive ones like a 60% reduction to overall file size. Now the demo is a tasty 800mb!

The Introduction of the FILES Menu is also added in this menu. Now documents and puzzle hints can be logged and saved... Neat! 
You will experience a much more fleshed out version of this system in the Full Game's Story mode![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946061/722640a87e58519128723de58f3d5ba09ab7c546.png"]

Player and UX Experience overhauls come all throughout the update. Primarily trough the inclusion of a Brand New Settings Menu found in both the Start & The In-game Menu. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946061/7922d466bfd2eaf5d1997ca08aa0685186ca7d9a.png"]

Here are some of the more notable raw and unfiltered patch notes!

New Additions/ Improvements

Game Build size reduced by 60%+

Performance improvements across the board.

Inventory Screen Upgrades UI/UX

Settings Screen Added to Main Menu

Graphic Styles Toggles Added

Proper Vsync Support Added

Retro Aspect Ratio Support Added 4:3, 16:10

New resolutions added!

Performance Enhancements across the board

Potato Mode Added?

3D Character Model on Inventory Screen

3D Item Previews

Documents System  Re-Integrated

Map System Re-Integrated

Map System Keeps track of Key Items

Dynamic Status Condition Lights on Inventory Screen

Revamped Control schemes L2+R2 Aiming, Shooting

Analog Stick Press for Sprint (toggle)

Revamped PlayerMovement

AlternatePlayerMovement Refactorized and Upgraded.

Camera Transition smoothing added for Alternate Controls

Input Unlock angle cooldown and boost parameters.

Tank Control Rotation Speed tweaked

Examine UI Upgrades, Zoom in feature, Polished Interface

Examine UI Interactable Events added (Check Hipoint-C9)

Variety updated 2D Sprite work across the board

Revamped Fixed Cameras

Dolly camera view toggle added for certain cameras. Press Q (R3)

Camera Look around system implemented. Mouse/(Right Analog)

Demo Disc Level Various updated Camera work across the work

Added Lacey’s Signature weapon to her inventory

Added Rusty Pipe to Demo Disc Level

Added ??? to Demo Disc Level

Added New Tutorial Segments to Demo Disc Level

Added New FILES to Demo Disc Level.

Improved Demo Character Select menus



Various Misc Bug fixes

Fixed Angel Tape examine model

Fixed Variety persistent savedata issues

Fixed First Person Camera controls

Fixed First Person Camera being able to be toggled while in Examine UI

Fixed Luke’s (Lookable IK system)

Fixed BookPuzzle Saving Glitch

Fixed Angel Tape not consuming on Use

Fixed Luke’s Two handed Melee Animations

Fixed Worn Screwdriver textures

Fixed Flashlight defined for Grace’s Inventory

Fixed Angel Room Door texture on exit.

Laser sight intensity on Handguns is much more visible

Fixed Collision in Room 103

Fixed Cockroach Bags

Fixed Flashlight sfx playing after certain interactions

Fixed Health indicator appearing on start.

Fixed UI Main Menu Buttons not being clickable with mouse cursor

Fixed Audio leveling on StartScreen

Added missing animations to Luke’s Model Previews

Added missing animations to Luke’s Locomotion

Fixed Character select 3D rotate root transform glitch

Fixed Room 999 Ambience bug

Fixed Small roach Collision

Tweaked Item Pickup Jingle (now only for KeyItems)

Fixed Double Hitbox on Giant Roaches.

Updated Navmeshing on Demo Disc Level.

Updated Clock Puzzle closeup camera soft-lock

Updated Book Puzzle closeup camera and Interaction System

Fixed Music Triggers for Forest, Room 100, Rat's Nest, and the Outside areas.



Please consider joining the Discord! Feedback is crucial over here at Hen studios! We would love to hear your thoughts on how to improve the game. But also I'd love to hear what you currently love and wish to see more of! 



Thank you! - HedProtag

notes.title: Hotfix 2.0
notes.content:
Hotfix 2.0! Includes:
First person camera now functions as intended, a close-up FPS view only available when idle and not holding a weapon

Medallion podium state saves correctly after loading

Shooting range timer applies when combining ammo with gun on inventory

Variety bugs squashed

Refactorized dolly cameras across the board, less nauseating camera dynamics

Total Graphical overhaul/environment textures and material assigns across the board updated

Character texturing and vertex colouring updated

Fixed variety camera trigger dead spots

Fixed End level area dead spots

Fixed missing player collision in key areas

Updated more missing game assets

Tweaked visibility of certain puzzle objectives

Variety player experience improvements

UI/Menu updates

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0
notes.content:
Fixed initialisation issue with animations after loading a game, but also while saving. Until I fully address how animations are initialised, your weapon will be unequipped when you save a game, this is fine: You can just re-equip it after ^^

3 major bugs were caused by this and are now fixed:

Getting stuck in the saving menu

Animations not working properly after loading a save

Bookshelf puzzle not being interactable after loading such a save

I will continue working on your feedback, for now this will allow you to fully play the demo with no major issues heheh

Have fun!
